subject: ☕ Markets, a robotaxi delay, and one very public layoff memo
preview: Good morning. Equities wobbled, Waymo pushed a city launch, and a CEO tried to sound casual about cuts.
body:
Good morning.

Markets: S&P slipped 0.4% on a hotter PCE print. Treasury yields did the usual thing.

Tech: Waymo delayed its Miami launch by a quarter. Cruise is still quiet.

Work: A 40-person startup posted their layoff note on LinkedIn before they emailed staff. We have thoughts, none of them generous.

Hit reply if you want this less often. Or don't. We'll keep showing up.

subject: notes from the Berlin customer call?
preview: Hey, do you still have the raw notes from Tuesday? I want to send Klaus a recap before Monday.
body:
Hey,

Do you still have the raw notes from Tuesday's call with Klaus? I started a recap and realized I don't have the bit about their SSO timeline.

If you can dump them in the shared doc, or just paste here, I'll clean it up.

Also: they asked if we can do a security questionnaire this month. I told them maybe. Don't kill me.

Priya

body:
Hello,

Following Tuesday: we need written confirmation of Okta support and a completed SIG Lite.
